name: Bhagavad Gita 3.9
text:
यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः ।
तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर ॥
meaning: Work done as an offering frees; work done for oneself alone binds. So act, free of attachment, as an offering.
purpose: A verse on turning ordinary work into an offering.
supports: Finding meaning in daily work; generosity.
when: At the start of the working day.
